author: John Eldridge
title: Woman found dead on Florentine Way in Virginia Beach - NewsBreak
text:
By John Eldridge ,
2 hours ago
VIRGINIA BEACH, Va. (WAVY) – A woman is dead following an incident on Florentine Way in Virginia Beach Wednesday evening.
According to officials, a report of a gunshot wound victim in the 5000 block of Florentine Way was received at approximately 6:30 p.m.
When Virginia Beach police officers and EMS arrived, they located an adult female deceased.
Officials say that there is no current threat to the public.
No additional information has been released at this time.
This is active and on-going investigation. 10 On Your Side will provide you with additional information when it becomes available.
Continue to check WAVY.com for updates .
